description: Fetch a Kew World Checklist of Vascular Plants taxon record by fqId ("wcvp:<id>" from search_plants, or an IPNI-style urn:lsid:ipni.org:names:304293-2). Returns the taxon's classification, family/genus, taxonomic status, native distribution (TDWG region codes), accepted-name resolution (for synonyms), and synonym count. Keyless authoritative botanical taxonomy.

fq_id.description: A POWO fqId like "urn:lsid:ipni.org:names:304293-2" (from search_plants results).

name: powo_get_taxon
title: Powo Get Taxon
